name: Large Electorate
rules: Two players compete in a Cambridge Vice-Chancellor election across 25 colleges, each with a specified number of Fellows. Each player simultaneously allocates up to 250 pennies among the colleges, using non-negative integers. The player donating more to a college receives all its Fellows' votes; tied donations award no votes. The player with more total votes wins; equal totals result in a draw. Invalid allocations automatically lose; if both allocations are invalid, the game is a draw.
